# apple_ci_workflow (Resource)

Creates an Xcode Cloud workflow: when builds start, with which Xcode and macOS version, and what they do. Xcode creates the product and connects the repository; find them with `data.apple_ci_products` and `data.apple_scm_repositories`. A workflow needs at least one start condition to start by itself; `apple_start_ci_build_run` starts one on demand. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_products" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}

data "apple_ci_xcode_versions" "all" {}

locals {
  product = data.apple_ci_products.app.products[0]
  xcode   = one([for v in data.apple_ci_xcode_versions.all.xcode_versions : v if v.version == "26.0"])
}

resource "apple_ci_workflow" "ci" {
  product_id          = local.product.id
  repository_id       = local.product.primary_repository_id
  xcode_version_id    = local.xcode.id
  mac_os_version_id   = local.xcode.mac_os_version_ids[0]
  name                = "CI"
  description         = "Builds and tests changes to main and pull requests into it."
  enabled             = true
  clean               = false
  container_file_path = "Example.xcodeproj"

  branch_start_condition = {
    source      = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main" }] }
    auto_cancel = true
  }

  pull_request_start_condition = {
    source      = { is_all_match = true }
    destination = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main" }] }
    auto_cancel = true
  }

  scheduled_start_condition = {
    source = { patterns = [{ pattern = "main" }] }
    schedule = {
      frequency = "WEEKLY"
      days      = ["MONDAY"]
      hour      = 6
      minute    = 0
      timezone  = "America/Los_Angeles"
    }
  }

  actions = [
    {
      name                = "Build - iOS"
      action_type         = "BUILD"
      scheme              = "Example"
      platform            = "IOS"
      destination         = "ANY_IOS_DEVICE"
      is_required_to_pass = true
    },
    {
      name                = "Test - iOS"
      action_type         = "TEST"
      scheme              = "Example"
      platform            = "IOS"
      destination         = "ANY_IOS_SIMULATOR"
      is_required_to_pass = true
      test_configuration = {
        kind = "USE_SCHEME_SETTINGS"
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (Attributes List) What the workflow does, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))
- `clean` (Boolean) Whether builds start without the cached data of earlier builds.
- `container_file_path` (String) Path of the Xcode project or workspace in the repository, e.g. `Example.xcodeproj`.
- `description` (String) Description of the workflow.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the workflow starts builds.
- `mac_os_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the macOS version, which must run the Xcode version; see `data.apple_ci_mac_os_versions`.
- `name` (String) Name of the workflow.
- `product_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode Cloud product. Changing it creates a new workflow.
- `repository_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the repository the workflow builds. Changing it creates a new workflow.
- `xcode_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode version; see `data.apple_ci_xcode_versions`.

### Optional

- `branch_start_condition` (Attributes) Starts a build when a branch changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_start_condition))
- `locked_for_editing` (Boolean) Whether only an Admin or Account Holder can edit the workflow. Defaults to `false`.
- `manual_branch_start_condition` (Attributes) Lets people start a build of a branch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_branch_start_condition))
- `manual_pull_request_start_condition` (Attributes) Lets people start a build of a pull request. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_pull_request_start_condition))
- `manual_tag_start_condition` (Attributes) Lets people start a build of a tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_tag_start_condition))
- `pull_request_start_condition` (Attributes) Starts a build when a pull request opens or changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pull_request_start_condition))
- `scheduled_start_condition` (Attributes) Starts a build of a branch on a schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_start_condition))
- `tag_start_condition` (Attributes) Starts a build when a tag is pushed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_start_condition))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode Cloud workflow.
- `last_modified_date` (String) When the workflow last changed.

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Required:

- `action_type` (String) Kind of action: `BUILD`, `ANALYZE`, `TEST`, `ARCHIVE`.
- `is_required_to_pass` (Boolean) Whether the workflow fails when the action does.
- `name` (String) Name of the action, e.g. `Build - iOS`.
- `scheme` (String) Xcode scheme the action uses.

Optional:

- `build_distribution_audience` (String) Who an archive action's build can go to: `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE`.
- `destination` (String) Where a build or test action runs: `ANY_IOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_IOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_TVOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_TVOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_WATCHOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_WATCHOS_SIMULATOR`, `ANY_MAC`, `ANY_MAC_CATALYST`, `ANY_VISIONOS_DEVICE`, `ANY_VISIONOS_SIMULATOR`.
- `platform` (String) Platform the action builds for: `MACOS`, `IOS`, `TVOS`, `WATCHOS`, `VISIONOS`.
- `test_configuration` (Attributes) What a test action tests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--test_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--actions--test_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.test_configuration`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Where the tests come from: `USE_SCHEME_SETTINGS`, `SPECIFIC_TEST_PLANS`.

Optional:

- `test_destinations` (Attributes List) Simulators or Macs to test on; `data.apple_ci_xcode_versions` lists the ones an Xcode version offers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions--test_configuration--test_destinations))
- `test_plan_name` (String) Name of the test plan, with `SPECIFIC_TEST_PLANS`.

<a id="nestedatt--actions--test_configuration--test_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions.test_configuration.test_destinations`

Optional:

- `device_type_identifier` (String) Identifier of the device type, e.g. `com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimDeviceType.iPhone-17`.
- `device_type_name` (String) Name of the device type, e.g. `iPhone 17`.
- `kind` (String) Kind of destination: `SIMULATOR`, `MAC`.
- `runtime_identifier` (String) Identifier of the runtime, e.g. `default`.
- `runtime_name` (String) Name of the runtime, e.g. `Latest from Selected Xcode`.

- `source` (Attributes) Branches the condition applies to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--branch_start_condition--source))

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_ci_workflow.ci
  identity = {
    id = "7e9a1c3d-5f2b-4a6c-8d0e-3b4c5d6e7f8a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Xcode Cloud workflow.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_ci_workflow.ci 7e9a1c3d-5f2b-4a6c-8d0e-3b4c5d6e7f8a
```
